notes.title: Demo Patch #3
notes.content:
[b]Bugs Fixed[/b]
-Fixed enemy spawning so it's more balanced
-Performance optimizations
-Options will now save between sessions
-Fixed audio bugs not playing in the Main Menu and in game
-Made some more tweaks to the procedural generation

We'll continue patching and improving the game, we're current working on some additional content that we're hoping to deploy soon. Please submit bug reports and your feedback so we can make this the best kaiju game out there!

Happy Wrecking!

notes.title: Demo Patch #2
notes.content:
We're super pleased with the turnout the demo is having if you haven't wishlisted, please do. Every wishlist counts and helps us reach a wider audience! On to the fixes!

-Fixed sound distortion issue when too many enemies firing projectiles
-Tweaked XP drop size
-Changed plasma bolt values to make it more splashy when it splits
-Tweaked eye laser sizes and firerate. Increased number enemies it penetrates by default.

Might be a bit till next update but tackling larger issues that require a little more dev investment. If you see any issues be sure to swing by the Discord channel and drop it in #bug-reports. Thanks!

Happy Wrecking!

notes.title: Demo Patch #1
notes.content:
[b]Bugs Fixed[/b]
-Fixed magnet upgrade and magnet radius.
-Increased number of XP drops from enemies.
-Added disable damage popups to in-game menu
-Fixed flavor text on Radioactive Glow in weapon select

Issues Still Present
-Weapon Select not working as intended
-Some upgrades still not working as intended and have been disabled
-Enemy spawning still getting caught on obstacles
